description: Implementation of the SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase class managing SQLite database operations, including initialization, schema migration, error handling, and background task management within the 'net' namespace.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase
classes.description: A class managing SQLite database persistence, including initialization, schema migration, error handling, and background task execution.

methods.name: SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing database backend with configuration parameters.

methods.name: ~SQLitePersistentStoreBackendBase
methods.description: Destructor ensuring proper cleanup and validation.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the database backend, either immediately or in background.

methods.name: SetBeforeCommitCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback to be invoked before committing transactions.

methods.description: Initializes the database, including schema migration and setup.

methods.description: Performs additional initialization steps; default returns true.

methods.description: Resets the database, clearing data and resetting state.

methods.description: Commits current transaction, invoking pre-commit callback.

methods.description: Handles database schema migration and recovery.

methods.name: DatabaseErrorCallback

methods.description: Razes and poisons the database, resetting internal state.
